subject: [PATCH v3 2/2] mm/page_alloc: refactor build_node_zonelist() out of build_zonelists()

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch refactors the build_node_zonelist() function out of build_zonelists(). It extracts per-node fallback-list construction into a separate function, allowing new zonelists to be built from candidate nodemasks instead of just the default N_MEMORY node state list. The patch also adds a zlidx argument to callers so they can explicitly select the destination zonelist. This change does not introduce any functional changes and maintains the same fallback list as before.
